how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:paladin-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7644:obj:0: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7644:details:0: As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows ever so slightly. The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.
rows.quest:7644:details:1: BIt would seem that the barding has been blessed. As per Lord Shadowbreaker's instructions, you should now return with it to him in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7644:completion:0: You've come far, my friend. Your barding is now suitably prepared for the last task at hand.
rows.quest:7644:completion:1: BYou will be using this barding to harness your charger once the task of redemption is complete. Before that, however, you will have a monumental struggle to overcome. Your time draws near - huzzah!
rows.quest:7644:completion:2: BThere is one last item that needs to be made before we begin this, ⟦1⟧. Hopefully your resourcefulness has not departed you since you had your barding made...
rows.quest:7645:obj:0: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
rows.quest:7645:obj:1: BYou also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.
rows.quest:7645:details:0: The Silver Hand thought me MAD when I told them that I could make a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses. EVERYONE thought I was mad! Well, now it's payback time!
rows.quest:7645:details:1: BI'll make what you need, PALADIN... so-called CHAMPION... but it will cost you. I need special biscuits - Enriched Manna Biscuits sold only by the Argent Dawn - for this blend. I also demand, yes DEMAND gold as compensation for the misery I have endured!
rows.quest:7645:details:2: BShow me the sacrifice you tout so much, PALADIN.
rows.quest:7645:completion:0: YES, NOW WHO - wait - you're giving me the gold too? You weren't the one who called me mad (actually they called me a fruitcake nut-job)... still, you're willing to show sacrifice even for wrongs you've not committed?
rows.quest:7645:completion:1: BI... I misjudged you, ⟦2⟧. Should you need more horse feed, come see me. I will give it to you free of charge. Thank you... noble ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:7645:completion:2: BI am going to keep the money though - I'm not that much of a nut-job as to give up a fortune.
rows.quest:7646:obj:0: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7646:details:0: We now must assemble a Divination Scryer - this will begin the trial that will allow you to redeem the fallen charger. Your scryer, actually, is almost done. The exorcism censer used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I will fashion a suitable housing for the device.
rows.quest:7646:details:1: BThe last components needed, though, are two diamonds. They must be as juxtaposed in brilliance as they are in purpose - an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the shadows!
rows.quest:7646:completion:0: These are fine specimens, ⟦4⟧ - the final pieces are now in place. At long last, your time has come!
rows.quest:7646:completion:1: BIn the depths of the Great Ossuary of Scholomance are the skeletal remains of many beings. Amongst them is a once-noble charger. The hollowed soul of this charger now serves as the steed for Death Knight Darkreaver. It is he whom you will face, and it is this steed that you will pass judgment upon. Only you, ⟦5⟧, can redeem its soul and save it from the torment of its servitude.
rows.quest:7647:obj:0: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
rows.quest:7647:obj:1: BGive the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
rows.quest:7647:details:0: Take this satchel - in it are the items you will need for your task.
rows.quest:7647:details:1: BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits that must be judged. Use your judgments wisely during this trial - they will prove more potent than you realize. After the spirits, the death knight will appear; defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the charger. Only then ⟦6⟧, will you be able to redeem it and place your barding upon your new steed!
rows.quest:7647:completion:0: A glimmer of life - long vacant from the poor beast - shines in its eyes as you hand its judged soul back to it. You feel a holy rush of power surge around you as you place the barding on its back, having judged the charger redeemed. The charger nuzzles your hand as the burdens of the past are lifted from the beast. You now feel as though you could call upon this beast to serve as your steed, should the need arise.
rows.quest:7647:completion:1: BYou have claimed your epic charger, ⟦7⟧! Congratulations!
rows.quest:7648:obj:0: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in ⟦E1⟧'s Cathedral District for his inspection.
rows.quest:7648:details:0: <Grimand wipes sweat from his brow, beaming with a sense of pride.>
rows.quest:7648:details:1: BThere you are, my friend. This is some of my finest work - as good as the barding I personally made for Lord Shadowbreaker when he went for his own charger. I thank you for your trust in me to provide for you the best.
rows.quest:7648:details:2: BNo doubt Grayson will want to see the work for himself as well. Take your barding to him, and give him my thanks for his honorable business.
rows.quest:7648:completion:0: This is most impressive work. It seems that as Grimand gets older, his craftsmanship continues to improve. That's quite the feat when his work was already some of the finest you'd find anywhere when he made my barding back in the day.
rows.quest:7648:completion:1: BWhile this barding would be a fine addition to any normal steed, we are not dealing with such a mundane beast. You'll need this barding blessed by an appropriate source for it to be worthy of resting on a ⟦8⟧'s charger. I'll hold onto it for you until then.
rows.quest:8414:obj:0: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8414:details:0: Greetings, ⟦9⟧. Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.
rows.quest:8414:details:1: BYour holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here. We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis. The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.
rows.quest:8414:details:2: BOnly one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.
rows.quest:8414:completion:0: There is risk in dispelling the evil from a scourgestone, for it attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. But you are strong in the Light, ⟦10⟧, and I do not fear for you...
rows.quest:8415:obj:0: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.
rows.quest:8415:details:0: Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, ⟦11⟧. You can find him at Chillwind Camp in the southern part of the ⟦E4⟧. Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!
rows.quest:8415:completion:0: Very well, ⟦12⟧! Let's see what you're made of.
rows.quest:8416:obj:0: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.
rows.quest:8416:details:0: The evil has been purged from the stones, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:8416:details:1: BI am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone. Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.
rows.quest:8416:completion:0: You have done as I asked without question, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:8416:completion:1: BTrust is achieved, it seems. Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.
rows.quest:8418:obj:0: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
rows.quest:8418:details:0: Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead. This is no trivial task, ⟦15⟧. Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.
rows.quest:8418:details:1: BIn the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.
rows.quest:8418:completion:0: This is excellent, ⟦16⟧. I would say I am surprised, but I knew without question that you wouldn't let us down.
rows.quest:8418:completion:1: BIt is my honor to bestow one of the Holy Mightstones to you. Use it well.
